title: Cards that share their rows
summary: grid-template-rows: subgrid lines up titles, text and buttons across cards.
explanation: Each card spans three rows of the outer grid (grid-row: span 3) and is itself a grid whose rows are the subgrid of those three. The title, text and button of every card therefore sit on the same three shared rows, so a long title in one card makes the title row taller for all of them.
Without subgrid, each card sizes its own rows from its own content, and buttons end up at different heights. The usual workaround was fixed heights or margin-top: auto; subgrid needs neither.
A subgrid inherits the parent's gap between its rows unless you override it, which is why the cards have their row spacing from .cards.
tryThis: Replace grid-template-rows: subgrid with 1fr 1fr 1fr (in .card): the buttons stop lining up.
Make a card's text much longer: the text row grows for every card.
Change repeat(3, 1fr) to repeat(2, 1fr) and delete a card: the cards that remain still share their rows.
